items.title: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal Invites Polish Firms to ‘Build, Innovate and Grow with India’
items.summary: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal delivered the keynote address at the India-Poland Business Forum here today which was also attended by Poland’s Prime Minister Donald Tusk . Sonowal recalled that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Poland in August 2024 lifted ties to a strategic partnership.

facts.text: Sonowal cited that India, under the dynamic leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has set an ambitious target to generate 500 GW of non-fossil fuel power capacity by 2030, to put forth a strong Climate Action step by the country.
He put the investment needed at roughly 280 billion to 300 billion euros, with openings for equipment makers, storage, power grids, green hydrogen, recycling and environmental technology.
Trade between the two countries has reached $6.36 billion, and Indian investment in Poland exceeds $3 billion, Sonowal said.
He urged business leaders to see the India-EU free trade agreement as more than a trade pact.
